purpose: W1 release qualification: full-duration 50/s generator/capture validation at the exact W1 shape. Separate ID; not one of the 60 proposed attempts. NOT a fixed-point result and never reported as one.
deviations: Qualification only: separate run ID and seed; never counted as a proposed W attempt.
Reproduces the W1 attempt shape exactly (adapter, devices, rate, 300/600 s, 150/150 VU pool, 5000 ms timeout).
VU headroom is intentionally unprovisioned beyond 150: rate x timeout = 250 worst-case in-flight, so this run is the test of whether the pool binds.
Existing deployed state, device cohorts and history are retained; not a cold-start repetition.
